name: chefbear
description: Helps you decide what to order from a restaurant menu and connects ChefBear, the iPhone menu scanner by Awesome-Bears, Inc., through its hosted remote MCP server to save, import, find, read and share your ChefBear menus. Sign-in is OAuth, approved in the ChefBear iPhone app; it needs a free ChefBear account (accounts in the mainland China service region can't connect) and is not related to the Bear notes app.
